comments.author: Shalke97
comments.body: So, does this only work with pixel art? Whats the max resolution for your tool?

replies.author: Rsloth
replies.body:
https://preview.redd.it/8unhti6997dh1.png?width=2204&format=png&auto=webp&s=dafd41fe3b5f7e45be43e7ffcff99d0d1bcd889d

You can generate variants of assets that have 1px brush. Everything is pixels / raster. Built into the editor so you can edit / redraw / recolor / erase any pixels

replies.author: Rsloth
replies.body:
By default new generated assets look something like this.  
You can choose your size when generating or scale inside the editor to the desired size.

comments.author: minicoman
comments.body: Is this going to be subscription based?  And does it train the model with the art uploaded?

replies.author: Rsloth
replies.body: Subscription. User-uploaded images and generated content are explicitly **not** used to train the underlying AI models. You retain full ownership.
